paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter with spin-based amplifiers
notes: Paper presents NEW measured exclusion limits on axion-like particle (ALP) coupling to nucleons using a spin-based amplifier with hyperpolarized 129Xe nuclear spins. Mass range: 8.3 feV to 744 feV (8.3e-15 to 7.44e-13 eV). Best limit at 67.5 feV: g_aN < 2.9×10^-9 GeV^-1 (95% CL), improving previous laboratory limits by >5 orders of magnitude. The coupling is to nucleons (primarily neutrons via spin interaction), making AxionNeutron the appropriate type. DM density assumed is standard galactic halo value ρ_a ≈ 0.4 GeV/cm^3. Data points extracted from Fig. 4b (blue line, 100s data) and text statement of best limit. The experiment also constrains dark photon-nucleon coupling and ALP quadratic coupling, but primary result is on g_aN. Confidence in coupling type assignment is high (0.92) because: (1) abstract and title clearly state 'axion-like dark matter', (2) paper explicitly discusses 'coupling of ALPs to nucleons', (3) mechanism is nuclear spin precession via Zeeman interaction, (4) comparison with CASPEr and other NMR-based searches confirms nucleon coupling interpretation. | selector: text (sole candidate)
